prompt: Name a tavern, bar or inn
blurb: Anywhere a pint gets poured, on the Isles or on the road there.

answers.name: The Theocrat
answers.note: Vlad the Kisser does weekend shows there for the late drinkers at final tonic call.
answers.quote: working part time at the Theocrat. He does shows on the weekend to the few late-night drinkers

answers.name: Hall of Ale
answers.note: The brewers' hall in Aleforge, where a different family hosts a keg tap each month.
answers.quote: Once a month the brewers gather here for a grand feast and keg tap

answers.name: The labyrinth tavern
answers.note: An improbable tavern deep in the labyrinth beneath Hoegaarden.
answers.quote: we found a MARVELOUS tavern in this foul labyrinth

answers.name: The cannibal tavern
answers.note: Where Guinnie got dosed twice before chasing the green frog into the woods.
answers.quote: the tavern I had just escaped was a front for ritualistic cannibalism

answers.name: The pub in Gyntonick
answers.note: Where Jack Anqoak robbed a Commodore and framed his brother Rum.
answers.quote: a night drowned in rye at the pub in Gyntonick
